chunks.head: get acquainted with
chunks.note: get acquainted with sb/sth = 开始认识、逐渐熟悉。
chunks.ex_en: I got acquainted with my neighbours at the party.
chunks.ex_cn: 我在聚会上结识了邻居们。

chunks.head: take a fancy to
chunks.note: take a fancy to sb/sth = (一下子)喜欢上某人或某物。
chunks.ex_en: The old man took a fancy to the little kitten.
chunks.ex_cn: 老人一下子喜欢上了那只小猫。

chunks.head: have a mind to
chunks.note: have a mind to do = 有意、打算做某事。
chunks.ex_en: I have a mind to try that new noodle shop.
chunks.ex_cn: 我很想去试试那家新面馆。

chunks.head: take an observation
chunks.note: 航海固定搭配:用仪器观测太阳或星辰,算出所在纬度/位置。

literal.note_cn: 此处指天文测位,非泛指'观察'

chunks.ex_en: The captain took an observation at noon to find the ship's position.
chunks.ex_cn: 船长在正午观测测位,以确定船的方位。

chunks.head: come up with
chunks.note: 本章义为'追上、赶上'(船只);另有'想出(主意)'义,注意区分。
chunks.ex_en: The fast runner soon came up with the leaders.
chunks.ex_cn: 那名快跑的选手很快追上了领先者。

chunks.head: bring to
chunks.note: 航海固定搭配:调整帆使船停下不前;也说 heave to。
chunks.ex_en: The sailors brought to and waited for the storm to pass.
chunks.ex_cn: 水手们顶风停船,等风暴过去。

chunks.head: cut short
chunks.note: cut sth short = 提前结束、长话短说。
chunks.ex_en: We had to cut short our trip because of the rain.
chunks.ex_cn: 因为下雨,我们不得不缩短了旅程。

chunks.head: be obliged to
chunks.note: be obliged to do = 迫于形势只得做;另有'感激'义(be obliged to sb),此处为'被迫'。
chunks.ex_en: The heavy snow meant we were obliged to stay at home.
chunks.ex_cn: 大雪使我们不得不待在家里。

chunks.head: set at liberty
chunks.note: set sb at liberty = 释放某人(使自由)。
chunks.ex_en: The captured bird was set at liberty in the forest.
chunks.ex_cn: 那只被抓的鸟在森林里被放归自由。

chunks.head: man-of-war
chunks.note: 航海固定名词:旧时的武装战舰(整体一词,man 非'人')。
chunks.ex_en: A great man-of-war sailed into the harbour, its guns ready.
chunks.ex_cn: 一艘巨大的军舰驶入港口,炮口已经备好。

chunks.head: look after
chunks.note: look after sb/sth = 照顾、看管。
chunks.ex_en: Please look after my dog while I'm away.
chunks.ex_cn: 我不在时请帮我照看一下狗。

chunks.head: fit out
chunks.note: fit out a ship = 为船只备齐装备、给养,使可出海。
chunks.ex_en: They spent a month fitting out the boat before the voyage.
chunks.ex_cn: 出航前,他们花了一个月给船配齐装备。

chunks.head: shoulder-of-mutton sail
chunks.note: 航海固定搭配:一种三角形的帆,形似羊腿(shoulder of mutton)得名,mutton 非指'羊肉'。

literal.note_cn: 此处非食物,仅借'羊腿'形状

chunks.ex_en: The small boat carried a shoulder-of-mutton sail shaped like a triangle.
chunks.ex_cn: 那条小船挂着一面三角形的羊腿帆。

chunks.head: haul in
chunks.note: haul in the sail = 把帆收拢;也可用于拉网、拉绳。
chunks.ex_en: The fishermen hauled in the net full of fish.
chunks.ex_cn: 渔夫们把满是鱼的网拉了上来。

chunks.head: take no notice of
chunks.note: take no notice of sb/sth = 对…置之不理(take notice of 的否定固定式)。
chunks.ex_en: She took no notice of the rude remark and walked on.
chunks.ex_cn: 她没理会那句无礼的话,径直走了。

chunks.head: come to an anchor
chunks.note: 航海固定搭配:抛下锚使船停住停泊。
chunks.ex_en: At dusk the ship came to an anchor near the small island.
chunks.ex_cn: 黄昏时船在小岛附近抛锚停泊。

chunks.head: give over
chunks.note: give over = 停下、不再做(此处指追赶'作罢')。
chunks.ex_en: After hours of searching, they gave over and went home.
chunks.ex_cn: 找了几个小时后,他们作罢回家了。

chunks.head: weigh anchor
chunks.note: 航海固定搭配:把锚拉起来准备开船,weigh 此处为'起(锚)'非'称重'。
chunks.ex_en: At dawn the crew weighed anchor and left the bay.
chunks.ex_cn: 拂晓时船员起锚,离开了海湾。

chunks.head: slip a cable
chunks.note: 航海固定搭配:来不及起锚时松开/放掉锚缆,以便迅速离开。
chunks.ex_en: In a hurry they slipped the cable and rowed off to sea.
chunks.ex_cn: 情急之下他们放掉锚缆,划船出海。

chunks.head: stand off to sea
chunks.note: 航海固定搭配:stand off = 朝远离陆地的方向航行。
chunks.ex_en: As the wind rose, the captain chose to stand off to sea.
chunks.ex_cn: 风变大后,船长决定驶向外海。

chunks.head: take heart
chunks.note: take heart = 打起精神、重拾信心。
chunks.ex_en: Take heart—things will get better soon.
chunks.ex_cn: 振作点,情况很快就会好起来。

chunks.head: take care of
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(take more care of himself),故 card-only。
chunks.ex_en: You should take care of your teeth by brushing twice a day.
chunks.ex_cn: 你该每天刷两次牙,照顾好牙齿。

chunks.head: take pains
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(take such pains),故 card-only。take pains (to do) = 不辞辛苦地做。
chunks.ex_en: She took pains to make the room look perfect.
chunks.ex_cn: 她费尽心思把房间布置得十全十美。

chunks.head: give chase to
chunks.note: give chase to (sb/sth) = 追赶、追击某人/某物;此处指萨累的土耳其海盗船扬帆猛追他们的船。

literal.note_cn: 非'给'义(与 chase 连用=发起追逐)

chunks.ex_en: The police gave chase to the runaway car.
chunks.ex_cn: 警察追赶那辆逃跑的汽车。

chunks.head: lose sight of
chunks.note: lose sight of (sth) = 再也看不见、看不到…的踪影;此处指浓雾中看不见海岸了。
chunks.ex_en: In the thick crowd I lost sight of my friend.
chunks.ex_cn: 在拥挤的人群里,我看不见我的朋友了。

chunks.head: a great deal of
chunks.note: a great deal of + 不可数名词 = 大量的、很多的;此处 a great deal of labour=费了很大力气。

literal.note_cn: 与 deal 连用表'大量'(非'伟大'义)

chunks.ex_en: She spent a great deal of time on the project.
chunks.ex_cn: 她在这个项目上花了大量时间。

chunks.head: put off
chunks.note: put off (doing sth) = 把…推迟、延后;此处指客人因故推掉了这趟出行。

literal.note_cn: 与 off 连用=推迟(非'放置'义)

chunks.ex_en: Don't put off your homework until the last minute.
chunks.ex_cn: 别把作业拖到最后一刻。

chunks.head: take by surprise
chunks.gloss: 使措手不及、出其不意地袭击(抓住)
chunks.note: take sb by surprise = 趁人不备、出其不意地下手/抓住某人;本章为可分式,宾语插在中间(took him by surprise)。

literal.note_cn: 与 by surprise 连用=趁不备下手(非'拿'义)
此处名词'冷不防'(非'惊喜'义)

chunks.ex_en: The sudden question took the boy by surprise.
chunks.ex_cn: 那个突如其来的问题让男孩措手不及。

chunks.head: cheer up
chunks.note: cheer sb up = 使某人高兴、打起精神;本章为可分式,宾语插在中间(cheer him up)。
chunks.ex_en: I told a joke to cheer up my little sister.
chunks.ex_cn: 我讲了个笑话逗我妹妹开心。
